function: Learned denoising, compression and restoration of beam measurements fed back by users (CSI feedback), used as equivalent channel for coordinated hybrid beamforming. p. 2-3, 5.
system: Multi-cell downlink mmWave massive MIMO: 3 BSs with 16x16 UPA and 64 RF chains, 20 single-antenna users, 28 GHz, no RIS. p. 3, 7.
method: BeamNet: non-learned top-S principal-component extraction plus quantizer at the user, Swin-transformer decoder at the BS; supervised offline training with MSE loss. p. 5-6.
data_channel: Own simulator: Saleh-Valenzuela channel with 3GPP path loss, log-normal shadowing; 2000 drops give 120,000 samples split 8:1:1 into train, validation, test. p. 3, 7-8.
test_conditions: Same simulated setup for training and testing (held-out 10%); models trained at one feedback dimension (8 to 128) tested at others; mixed-dimension model-G. p. 8, 10.
baselines: Non-learned: top-S RSRP beam-reporting benchmark; perfect-CSI fully digital and hybrid ICIC, local-CSI schemes. Learned: CsiNet, TransNet CSI feedback. p. 8, 11.
metrics: Feedback NMSE, achievable sum-rate, SINR CDF, feedback overhead reduction, parameters, memory and FLOPs. p. 8-11.
complexity: Table IV: BeamNet (8 blocks) 39 K parameters, 713 KB, 13.36 M FLOPs, versus CsiNet and TransNet; user-side sorting needs no multiplications. p. 11-12.
openness: none; no code or data link in the paper, data simulated by the authors. p. 8.
q1_support: p. 3: "we use the Saleh-Valenzuela" - custom simulator; only the path loss follows 3GPP (p. 7), no TR 38.901 channel, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "These models are then tested on different" - models trained at feedback dimension S=8 to 128 are tested at other S (Table III), a configuration not used in training.
q3_support: p. 8: "we compare it with two existing CSI feedback models" (CsiNet, TransNet) and a non-learned top-S RSRP benchmark; compared on NMSE (Table II) and sum-rate (p. 11).
q4_support: p. 11: "the number of trainable parameters, model storage space, and model FLOPs" - Table IV gives 39 K parameters, 713 KB, 13.36 M FLOPs for BeamNet.
q5_support: p. 8: "we conducted 2000 drops" - own simulated dataset; no code or data link and no public channel dataset or measured data.
notes: Learned part is only the CSI-feedback network BeamNet (area 2); the hybrid beamforming that uses the restored measurements is classical (energy-maximizing beam selection, SVD null space plus ZF, p. 7). q2 is 1 because the only new-condition test is across feedback dimensions (Table III, p. 10), a configuration change and not a new channel scenario, so the reviewer may confirm. q1 is 0 because the simulator is a custom Saleh-Valenzuela model with 3GPP path loss only. Tables I to IV were read from the page images of pages 7, 8, 10 and 11.
